record.field: Basic category to compute the net salary: the paid time types and every amount paid to or withheld from the employee.

Monthly wage of the labour contract forming the compulsory insurance contribution wage: the paid time types, the wage allowances and the fixed supplements agreed in the contract (Decree 158/2025/ND-CP, Art. 7). The floor and the ceilings are applied by the contribution rules.

Employment income subject to personal income tax: the paid time types and the taxable rules. Partially exempt items (meal allowance, overtime before 2026, housing benefit...) only bring their taxable portion through dedicated rules.
Personal, dependant, voluntary pension and charitable deductions reducing the taxable income into the assessable income of resident employees.
Overtime and night work pay, exempt from personal income tax for residents (fully from the 2026 tax period, the premium only before).
Social, health and unemployment insurance contributions withheld from the employee, deducted from the taxable income.
Hours worked between 22:00 and 06:00 are paid an additional 30% of the hourly wage (Labour Code, Art. 98(2)). Overtime at night earns a further 20% (Art. 98(3)).
Overtime on a weekly rest day is paid at least 200% of the hourly wage (Labour Code, Art. 98(1)(b)).
Public Holiday or Paid Leave Day
Overtime on a public holiday or a paid leave day is paid at least 300% of the hourly wage, on top of the pay of the day itself (Labour Code, Art. 98(1)(c)).
